The core mechanism relies on the distinction between equilibrium BECs, which require conserved particle numbers and ultra-low temperatures to minimize free energy (EV-Q078-084d625b26993ee8fd263402), and non-equilibrium condensates maintained by gain-loss balance (EV-Q078-fe220366ae53711042d58c89). The study quantifies 'widespread application' through Technology Readiness Levels (TRL), patent filing volumes, and prototype demonstrations. It specifically targets the prediction that polariton/photon device metrics will exceed atomic BEC metrics by an order of magnitude within a decade, leveraging the microcavity integration compatibility of non-equilibrium systems (EV-Q078-36c96a475442ca032df9aae2).
